shortDefinition.en: A single-lens reflex camera with digital image recording.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 采用数码影像记录的单镜头反光相机。

en: A digital camera is not necessarily a DSLR; a film SLR is not a DSLR.
zh-cn: 数码相机不一定是单反，胶片单反不是 DSLR。

example.en: DSLR and digital mirrorless differ in reflex viewing architecture.
example.zh-cn: DSLR 与数码无反的关键区别在于反光取景结构。

en: Read the two parts separately: digital specifies recording and single-lens reflex specifies viewing. Live view can use the sensor display even on a DSLR; distinguish the camera design from its current operating state.
zh-cn: 分开读名称的两部分：数码描述记录方式，单镜头反光描述取景路径。单反实时取景也可能使用传感器画面，需要区分机身设计与当前工作状态。
